title: Baritone Minecraft pathfinding system
content_excerpt: Baritone is a Minecraft pathfinding system with long-distance pathing, chunk caching, block breaking, and dangerous-block avoidance. Its command interface supports goals such as goto, mine, follow, explore, and build.
evidence_notes: High-value source for pathfinding tradeoffs, dangerous-block avoidance, mining command behavior, and path cost reasoning.
